snippet.title: Beat Breaker - Reveal & Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Yet another brick breaker game... but with a rhythm twist!

In the year 3060 humanity built advanced secure systems made of music.
The maximum experts of this kinda new wave of art are the Harckaders: Beat Breaker is their “simulator” (…is it really only that?) to help new people become familiar with the gig or simply entertain themselves.

This is Beat Breaker, first game of the White Phoenix Studios, solo-developed by Kojimo.

Join the alpha playtest now!
Itch.io page: https://wpstudios.itch.io/beat-breaker
Discord server: https://discord.gg/s6dJkumq48

Destroy the beat bricks!
